Name: Start With Greenhouse
Author: CaptainSully
Description:
[size=5]About[/size]
This will automatically and immediately unlock the greenhouse when the save is loaded; should work for any save old or new.
You'll have a cut-scene with Evelyn upon exiting your farmhouse because of this.

You will still be able to complete the pantry bundle, but you will never get the cut-scene for the greenhouse repair.
Note that this has a permanent effect on the save, uninstalling the mod won't re-lock the greenhouse. If you want to do that for some reason you could use something like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4]CJB Cheats Menu[/url].

There is a config option to disable the mod so it won't trigger (works with GMCM as well, but only on title screen). This will not effect saves that already have the greenhouse unlocked, even if they were unlocked by this mod; it will only prevent the mod from unlocking the greenhouse on a save that doesn't have it already.


[size=5]Updating/Installing[/size]
Completed remove any previous version of Start With Greenhouse.
Drop the "StartWithGreenhouse" folder into your Mods folder.


[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
No known compatibility issues in terms of running the game; HOWEVER note that this may cause weird timing behaviour with any mods that use the greenhouse being repaired as a trigger.
